title: Gemfile source declared over cleartext
description: Gemfile declares a gem source URL that uses cleartext http. Gems and their checksums cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can serve a different gem.
limitation: It matches a gem source URL that uses cleartext http in the parsed Gemfile; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
